package postgres

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func TestTeacherContextMutationFenceIsMonotonicAndConflictSafe(t *testing.T) {
	stored := domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{
		MessageSequence: 7, MessageVersion: 3, LastEventSequence: 62,
		Mutation: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationDeleted,
	}
	tests := map[string]struct {
		input   domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation
		advance bool
		err     error
	}{
		"newer": {
			input:   domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{MessageSequence: 7, MessageVersion: 4, LastEventSequence: 70, Mutation: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationUpdated},
			advance: true,
		},
		"reordered older": {
			input: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{MessageSequence: 7, MessageVersion: 2, LastEventSequence: 61, Mutation: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationUpdated},
		},
		"same semantic version": {
			input: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{MessageSequence: 7, MessageVersion: 3, LastEventSequence: 62, Mutation: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationDeleted},
		},
		"sequence drift": {
			input: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{MessageSequence: 8, MessageVersion: 4, LastEventSequence: 70, Mutation: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationUpdated},
			err:   domain.ErrDialogTeacherContextMutationConflict,
		},
		"same version drift": {
			input: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{MessageSequence: 7, MessageVersion: 3, LastEventSequence: 63, Mutation: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationDeleted},
			err:   domain.ErrDialogTeacherContextMutationConflict,
		},
		"nonmonotonic event": {
			input: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{MessageSequence: 7, MessageVersion: 4, LastEventSequence: 62, Mutation: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationUpdated},
			err:   domain.ErrDialogTeacherContextMutationConflict,
		},
	}
	for name, test := range tests {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			advance, err := shouldAdvanceTeacherContextMutationFence(stored, test.input)
			require.Equal(t, test.advance, advance)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, test.err)
		})
	}
}

func TestTeacherContextMutationReceiptComparisonIsExact(t *testing.T) {
	base := domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{
		SchemaVersion: 1, EventID: "event", EventType: domain.SubjectDialogTeacherContextMutated,
		DialogID: "dialog", StudentID: "student", PersonalTeacherID: "teacher",
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral, MessageID: "message",
		MessageSequence: 1, MessageVersion: 2, EventSequence: 2, LastEventSequence: 2,
		Mutation: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationUpdated,
	}
	require.True(t, sameTeacherContextMutation(base, base))
	drift := base
	drift.StudentID = "other"
	require.False(t, sameTeacherContextMutation(base, drift))
}
